title: Anakah and Tristan's off-world past lives and their mission to ease first contact

tellings.quote: They claim at this point to have memories of having lived outside of the Earth on other planets and other lifetimes and that they're on a mission

plain: Two people named Anakah and Tristan say they remember past lives lived away from Earth, on other planets, and that they are now here on a mission to make humanity's first contact with other beings go more smoothly. The researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a doctorate and talks with Michels about psychics and the afterlife, passes this on from what the pair have said: they "claim at this point to have memories of having lived outside of the Earth on other planets and other lifetimes and that they're on a mission." If true, it would mean some people now on Earth carry memories of lives elsewhere.
